name: muda-page
description: muda's browser bundle. DEV-TIME ONLY: the built output lives in internal/serve/assets and is committed; `just assets` rebuilds it. Nothing at runtime needs node.

scripts.kit-types: go mod download github.com/subaud-tools/tools-common && KIT_DIR=$(go list -m -f '{{.Dir}}' github.com/subaud-tools/tools-common) && test -n "$KIT_DIR" && cp -f "$KIT_DIR/localweb/page/assets/kit.d.ts" . && chmod 644 kit.d.ts
scripts.page-build: go mod download github.com/subaud-tools/tools-common && D=$(go list -m -f '{{.Dir}}' github.com/subaud-tools/tools-common)/localweb/page/build && test -d "$D" && mkdir -p build && cp -f "$D/eslint.base.mjs" "$D/probe.mjs" build/ && chmod 644 build/eslint.base.mjs build/probe.mjs
scripts.build: npm run --silent build:js && npm run --silent build:css
